notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey all,[/b][/p][p]We hope you’ve been enjoying the demo of [i]Cozy Littlequarium[/i] so far! We’re writing to you today to share an exciting update with plenty of new features, visual improvements, and quality-of-life upgrades!!
All designed to make your aquarium cozier than ever. 🌊✨[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]New Decorations to bring your aquarium to life:[/b]
🪸 [b]20 new decoration items[/b] to personalize your tank in creative ways!
🌾 [b]3 new ground textures[/b] to give the floor of your aquarium a fresh look.
💰 [b]Gold Boost rework[/b] – completely revamped to be more rewarding and balanced![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Fish Update:[/b]
🐟 [b]8 new fish species[/b] added for even more variety and cuteness!
🌈 [b]New “Super Fish” category[/b] – rare RGB fish for your collection.
⏱️ [b]Breeding time reduced[/b] from 10 minutes to just [b]5 minutes[/b] – less waiting, more swimming![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Aquarium Expansion:[/b]
🏪 A brand new [b]Shop[/b] has been added where you can purchase expansions!
🔓 While only one aquarium is available in the demo, this system lays the groundwork to unlock more tanks in the full game.
📏 You can now also [b]expand the capacity[/b] of your aquariums! Add more fish and creativity to a single space![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Visual Improvements:[/b]
🎨 Major [b]UI color adjustments[/b] to give the game a more elegant and polished look.
🧭 The interface is now more [b]intuitive, vibrant, and user-friendly[/b], making navigation smoother than ever![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]QOL Updates:[/b]
🍽️ Full [b]rework of the feeding system[/b] – feeding your fish is now more responsive and satisfying.
💎 [b]Gold and diamond collection system[/b] has been reworked to feel more rewarding, dynamic and also satisfying.
⚙️ [b]Quick-access shortcuts[/b] added for important settings.
🖥️ New option to [b]resize and reposition the game window[/b] to better fit your setup.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Thanks to all of you who submitted feedback! Several issues reported by the community have been fixed in this patch. Your support helps us make [i]Cozy Littlequarium[/i] even better![/p][hr][/hr][p]We hope you enjoy these updates and continue building your dream aquarium! Don’t forget to [b]wishlist the game[/b] and stay tuned for more updates! 💖🐠[/p][p]– Gabreu Senra[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey, Cozy Keepers!

We’re thrilled to bring you some fantastic updates to make your time in Cozy Littlequarium even more magical! From shiny new features to bug fixes that make the waters smoother, here’s what’s swimming your way:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447558/49fadb406d1d07eac1318700dc9ab571aef1e6cc.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h2]

What’s New:
[b]Automatic Collector![/b]
No more manual collection stress! The brand-new Automatic Collector gathers gold and diamonds dropped by nearby fish, so you can focus on what matters—decorating, breeding, and enjoying your cozy aquarium.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447558/dcbd3fc6ed4b24140e44f6f575e6dd183a99e19c.png[/img]

[b]Seagull Airdrop![/b]
A cheeky seagull may now visit your aquarium with a 70% chance every 12–18 minutes.

[b]Seagull Surprises:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447558/faf89ffddefaa90af6bef0fe3e7532963e99f14a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447558/faf89ffddefaa90af6bef0fe3e7532963e99f14a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447558/faf89ffddefaa90af6bef0fe3e7532963e99f14a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447558/faf89ffddefaa90af6bef0fe3e7532963e99f14a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447558/faf89ffddefaa90af6bef0fe3e7532963e99f14a.png[/img]
When the seagull stops by, it leaves a mysterious gift! These could be rare items, extra resources, or other delightful surprises to keep your aquarium vibrant and full of life. 


[b]Fixes:[/b]
[b]Balanced Fish Nutrition:[/b]
Resolved an issue where feeding a fish with a less nutritious food incorrectly replaced the effects of a higher-quality meal. Now your fish will enjoy the nutrition they deserve!

[b]Hermit Crab Animation:[/b]
Fixed a pesky bug where the Hermit Crab sometimes refused to come out of its shell—or got stuck outside it. Now it’s back to its charming, animated self!

We hope these updates make your aquarium even cozier! Keep growing your aquatic family, experimenting with decorations, and letting your creativity shine. As always, thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more exciting updates soon!

Happy aquascaping! 🐠💎🌿
